headline: Almost All Fed Policymakers Signal Further Interest Rate Hikes Likely
summary: Minutes from the U.S. Federal Reserve's latest meeting showed that almost all policymakers believe further interest rate hikes will be appropriate to address inflation.
why: Federal Reserve monetary policy decisions directly influence global borrowing costs, currency valuations, and asset prices across international financial markets.

impacts.name: Federal Funds Rate
impacts.why: FOMC meeting minutes indicate policymakers view further rate hikes as likely appropriate.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hawkish signals from central bankers increased expectations of tighter monetary policy, strengthening the US dollar.
